 Westchester election results take shape following polling delays
 According to Doug Colety, Republican Commissioner of the Westchester County Board of Elections, all early voting and Election Day ballots have been counted to date.

 Results are coming in from several Westchester County races following Election Day polling issues.
 According to Doug Colety, Republican Commissioner of the Westchester County Board of Elections, all early voting and Election Day ballots have been counted to date. 
 However, absentee and affidavit ballots are still being processed, and no results have been certified or made official as vote counting continues.
 News 12 also reached out to the Democratic Deputy Commissioner and has not heard back as of Saturday morning.
 Preliminary figures from the Board of Elections show a total of 181,106 emergency ballots processed over three days:
 • Emergency Ballots Scanned November 4: 15,467
 • Emergency Ballots Scanned November 5: 63,980
 • Emergency Ballots Scanned November 6: 101,659
 In the 15th District, Democrat Kisha Skipper is leading Republican James Nolan by about 250 votes.
 In the 3rd District, Democrat Michael Peppard is ahead of incumbent Republican Margaret Cunzio.
 If both Republican candidates are ultimately defeated, there would be no GOP members serving on the county board.
 In Mount Pleasant, Democrat Thomas Abinanti is ahead of incumbent Republican Supervisor Carl Fulgenzi.
 Meanwhile, in Yorktown, Republican incumbent Supervisor Ed Lachterman is leading Democrat Jann Marchandani by fewer than 1,000 votes.
 The Board of Elections website reflects vote totals counted so far, but election officials caution that outstanding absentee and affidavit ballots remain under review. 
 All results remain unofficial and are subject to further changes until the counting process is complete and results are formally certified.
 The Westchester County Board of Elections says that it will update its official website multiple times each day with the latest available emergency ballot processing statistics and relevant information.
